## Summary
Document the ownership model and the expected show/hide behavior for the Gym SLL demo.

## User impact
Contributors can follow the documented pattern instead of adding more ad hoc chrome visibility logic.

## Minimal End-to-End Slice
- **Code**: No runtime code beyond doc-snippet consistency checks.
- **Tests**: Ensure any referenced commands or snippets match the real test targets.
- **Docs**: Update `example-games/gym/README.md` and `docs/DEVELOPER.md` with ownership/visibility guidance.
- **Infra**: Reuse the existing docs structure.
- **Observability**: Document how to confirm visibility behavior in the browser demo.

## Existing implementation to reuse
- Gym SLL sections in `example-games/gym/README.md`
- SLL guidance in `docs/DEVELOPER.md`
- browser tests for the Gym demo

## Acceptance Criteria
- Docs explain which mode shows which chrome.
- Docs explain how to register objects as shell-owned or scene-owned.
- Docs mention that Scene-only suppresses shared shell chrome.
- Documentation changes match the implemented behavior.

## Dependencies
- Depends on: Gym scene wiring (CG-0MPFM2MM4003OPP8).
- Parent: Suppress shared Gym help chrome in pure scene-only SLL views (CG-0MPFLM5EB009N5X8).

## Goal

Make "won a game" a first-class, engine-generic achievement event so the give-away triggers have a real, Steam-free source.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AchievementSystem` (or a documented thin extension) gains an idempotent game-outcome surface (e.g. `onGameOutcome({ gameId, outcome })`) that unlocks mapped achievements via the existing `AchievementSink`; zero Steam/Electron imports.
- The launcher manifest defines `first-win` and `second-distinct-game-win` meta-achievements (titles, descriptions, hidden flags) and the outcome-to-achievement mapping is engine-generic.
- "Second distinct game" logic only unlocks after wins in two different game ids; re-wins of the same game do not.
- `SteamAchievementService` idempotence and offline paths are reused unchanged for the meta-achievements.
- Unit tests cover outcome-to-unlock, distinct-game counting, idempotence, and no-op for unknown outcomes; pass under `--project unit`.

## Key Files

- `src/core-engine/AchievementSystem.ts`
- `src/core-engine/index.ts`
- `electron/achievement-manifest.json`
- `tests/steam-achievements/achievement-outcome.test.ts` (new)

## Deliverables

Engine outcome surface, manifest meta-achievements, unit tests.
data.title: Engine game-outcome surface and cross-game meta-achievements

# Typed node-safe module manifest for `src/ui`

**Goal:** A single source of truth — a typed, machine-readable manifest of the
`src/ui` modules that are guaranteed importable in a plain Node environment (no
`window`, no Phaser evaluation), so downstream `tce-<game>` unit suites and
engine maintainers can *look up* node-safety instead of probing. Parent:
CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `src/ui/node-safe-modules.ts` exists and exports a readonly `as const`
      array (`uiNodeSafeModules`) of `src/ui` module paths; the file is itself
      Phaser-free and side-effect-free (a plain data module — no value imports,
      no module-scope side effects) so the check, the guard test and docs
      tooling can all import it.
- [ ] Every entry carries a one-line rationale comment (what it is / why it must
      stay framework-free).
- [ ] The initial list is the 15 intake candidates (`illegalMoveToast`,
      `illegalMoveToastView`, `shakeIllegalMove`, `dragDrop`, `screen-layout`,
      `screen-layout-compose`, `screen-layout-schema`, `constants`,
      `SettingsStore`, `card-pack-url`, `card-pack-client`, `game-asset-url`,
      `game-manifest`, `game-plugin-boot`, `content-unlock-client`); each entry
      is verified by the new static check during implementation, and any that
      prove Phaser-bearing is **dropped, not patched**.
- [ ] `tests/ui/node-safe-modules.test.ts` (or equivalent unit) asserts: entries
      are unique, non-empty strings with no duplicates; each entry maps to an
      existing `src/ui/<entry>.ts`; the manifest array type is readonly.
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Minimal implementation

- Create `src/ui/node-safe-modules.ts` with the list + one-line rationale per
  entry (no imports, `export const uiNodeSafeModules = [...] as const`).
- Add `tests/ui/node-safe-modules.test.ts` validating shape + file existence.
- Run the unit profile for the new test (`npx vitest run --project unit
  tests/ui/node-safe-modules.test.ts`).

## Key files

- `src/ui/node-safe-modules.ts` — NEW: the typed readonly manifest.
- `tests/ui/node-safe-modules.test.ts` — NEW: shape/file-existence test.

## Dependencies

- None (foundation; consumed by the static check, the guard test and the docs).
data.title: Typed node-safe module manifest for src/ui

# Teeth tests for the static import-graph check

**Goal:** Verify-before-implement — `tests/scripts/check-ui-node-surface.test.ts`
defines, through hermetic fixtures, the exact contract the static import-graph
check must satisfy, so the check (CG sibling impl item) is proven to have teeth
before it is promised. Parent: CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The test file covers all teeth cases from the parent AC 3:
      (a) a clean manifest exits 0;
      (b) a value `import Phaser from 'phaser'` entry fails with the offending
      path/module in the output;
      (c) a transitive failure through a path alias (`@core-engine/*` or
      `@ui/*`) fails and reports the full chain;
      (d) a **type-only** Phaser import passes (type-only edges are elided);
      (e) an unresolvable specifier inside `src/ui`/an alias fails closed
      (never a silent skip);
      (f) a listed module that does not exist fails;
      (g) the real repo manifest passes (a live regression gate).
- [ ] Fixtures are hermetic temp trees built by the tests themselves (injected
      via the check's `--manifest`/`--root` overrides), not checked-in fixture
      files that can drift.
- [ ] Tests run green under the unit profile and are deterministic (no network,
      no Vitest-in-Vitest, no bundler).
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Minimal implementation

- Write `tests/scripts/check-ui-node-surface.test.ts` against the planned CLI
  contract: `--manifest <path>` (alters the entry list), `--root <dir>` (alters
  the base dir for resolution), `--json`, exit 0 clean / non-zero with one line
  per violation (module + chain).
- Each case creates a mini source tree in a temp dir (via `node:fs`, cleaned up
  in teardown) and invokes the check's exported API / CLI on it.
- Run the unit profile for the new test; expect red until the check is
  implemented (this is the contract-defining slice).

## Key files

- `tests/scripts/check-ui-node-surface.test.ts` — NEW: the seven teeth cases.

## Dependencies

- None to create first (defines the contract); the implementation it drives is
  the sibling "Static import-graph check" item — edge F3 → F2.
data.title: Teeth tests define the static-check contract

data.description:
# Static import-graph check (TypeScript compiler API)

**Goal:** `scripts/check-ui-node-surface.ts` — a deterministic, seconds-fast,
compiler-based static check that walks the real import graph for every manifest
entry and fails when a listed module transitively reaches a Phaser **value**
import, so a reintroduced regression is caught here, not in 23 downstream game
suites with `window is not defined`. Parent: CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] For every entry in the manifest, resolves and walks the module graph using
      the **same `paths`/aliases as `tsconfig.json`** (all of
      `@core-engine/*`, `@card-system/*`, `@rule-engine/*`, `@ai/*`, `@ui/*`
      are followed, not skipped).
- [ ] Ignores **type-only** imports and re-exports (`import type`,
      `export type`, `import { type X }`) — elided at compile time — while a
      resolved `phaser` specifier reached through a **value** edge is a
      violation reported with the full offending chain
      (`src/ui/X.ts → src/ui/Y.ts → phaser`).
- [ ] **Fail closed:** an unresolvable specifier inside `src/ui`/an alias, a
      listed module that does not exist, and an unparseable manifest file are
      each a violation (never a warning, never a silent skip).
- [ ] CLI contract: exits `0` when every listed module is clean; non-zero with
      one line per violation (module, chain); supports `--json` for tests;
      supports `--manifest <path>` / `--root <dir>` overrides for hermetic
      fixture tests.
- [ ] The real repo manifest passes (green); all cases in the teeth-test item
      pass. Uses only the TypeScript compiler API (`typescript` devDependency —
      **no new dependency**).
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Minimal implementation

- Implement the compiler-API walker (resolve module specs via `tsconfig.json`
  `paths`; follow local + alias value edges; reject on `phaser` value edges).
- Add the CLI entry (`#!/usr/bin/env node`, argument parsing, exit codes).
- Run against the real manifest; iterate the teeth tests to green.

## Key files

- `scripts/check-ui-node-surface.ts` — NEW: the check.

## Dependencies

- Edge to the manifest item (consumes `uiNodeSafeModules`).
- Edge to the teeth-tests item (its passing tests are the contract).
data.title: Static import-graph check (TS compiler API)

# Manifest-driven node-import guard test

**Goal:** Extend `tests/ui/phaser-free-imports.test.ts` so it iterates the
manifest — every listed module is imported at runtime under the throwing
`phaser` mock — while keeping its negative control, so adding a manifest entry
automatically gets an evaluation-based guard too (the runtime proof that
complements the static check). Parent: CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The guard imports **every** manifest entry under the file-scoped throwing
      `vi.mock('phaser')` (no hard-coded four-entry list); a manifest addition
      automatically widens the guard.
- [ ] Keeps the `phaserMock.calls === 0` assertion for all guard targets
      (Phaser never evaluated at import time).
- [ ] Keeps the negative control (`@ui/Renderer` fails under the same mock and
      the mock call count increases) so the guard cannot silently pass.
- [ ] The mock stays file-scoped (never moved into a global setup file).
- [ ] Runs green under the unit profile; code comments cross-link
      CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Minimal implementation

- Refactor `tests/ui/phaser-free-imports.test.ts` to build its import list from
  `uiNodeSafeModules` (dynamic `import()` inside the test, asserting each
  namespace exports what the existing assertions expect where applicable).
- Keep the `@ui/Renderer` negative control unchanged in spirit.
- Run the unit profile for the file.

## Key files

- `tests/ui/phaser-free-imports.test.ts` — modified.
- `src/ui/node-safe-modules.ts` — consumed (depends on the manifest item).

## Dependencies

- Edge to the manifest item (consumes `uiNodeSafeModules`).
data.title: Manifest-driven node-import guard test

# npm script and hard-gate wiring for the node-surface check

**Goal:** `npm run check:ui-node-surface` exists and is a **hard gate** on the
implementation / dev-push path (Q2 → A): a reintroduced Phaser value import in a
listed module must fail the gate before it reaches downstream game suites.
Parent: CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `package.json` gains `"check:ui-node-surface"` running the check script
      (precedent: `npx tsx scripts/...`, deterministic, seconds, no network, no
      Vitest run).
- [ ] The check is a hard gate: wired so the build step `implement.py finish`
      runs (and the dev-push path) executes it first — recommended mechanism: a
      `"prebuild": "npm run check:ui-node-surface"` chained script, so every
      `npm run build` (the gate `implement.py finish` and PR CI run) starts with
      the static check. Gate lands exactly on `build`; `build:*`-style scripts
      are unaffected (npm pre/post hooks are script-name-scoped).
- [ ] Runs green on a clean tree; a deliberately introduced Phaser value import
      in a listed module makes the gate fail — the before/after command output
      is recorded in a comment on CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN (parent AC 5).
- [ ] The check's own unit coverage (`tests/scripts/check-ui-node-surface.test.ts`)
      is part of the unit profile gate.
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Minimal implementation

- Add the `check:ui-node-surface` script to `package.json`.
- Add the `prebuild` chain (verify green + deliberate red, record output on the
  parent).
- Confirm `npm run build` still succeeds; document the gate in the docs item.

## Key files

- `package.json` — NEW script + prebuild chain.

## Dependencies

- Edge to the static-check implementation item (runs its script).
data.title: npm script and hard-gate wiring

# Docs and barrel docblock for the node-safe surface

**Goal:** Make the manifest the authoritative, discoverable statement of the
node-safe `@ui` surface — retire the "probe with `vite-node` when in doubt"
advice, add the check + "adding a module" procedure, and state at the barrel's
own definition site that it is intentionally Phaser-bearing. Parent:
CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/DEVELOPER.md` § *Phaser-free `@ui` helper imports for Node tests*
      gains the manifest as the authoritative list (link + the "adding a module
      to the surface" procedure), states the check and its `npm run
      check:ui-node-surface` script, and replaces "when in doubt, probe with a
      `vite-node` import" with "look it up in the manifest; if it is not listed,
      treat it as Phaser-bearing".
- [ ] `src/ui/index.ts` gains a short docblock above `UI_VERSION`: the barrel is
      **intentionally** Phaser-bearing (`CardGameScene extends Phaser.Scene`),
      Node tests must import deep Phaser-free paths, and it points at the
      manifest + check.
- [ ] `docs/ui-animations.md` node-safe note (under the `shakeIllegalMove`
      import block) points at the manifest + check.
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` is updated only where the hard-gate wiring / new npm script
      changes documented developer workflow (Doc-Update Policy) — the prebuild
      gate does change the build workflow, so it must be documented; if the
      change is judged non-workflow-affecting, record that decision here
      instead.
- [ ] Code comments cross-link CG-0MVS9HBN3009HIQN.

## Minimal implementation

- Edit `docs/DEVELOPER.md`, `src/ui/index.ts`, `docs/ui-animations.md`, and
  (conditionally) `AGENTS.md`.
- Verify the docs read correctly and links resolve.

## Key files

- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — modified section.
- `src/ui/index.ts` — docblock above `UI_VERSION`.
- `docs/ui-animations.md` — node-safe note pointer.
- `AGENTS.md` — only if the workflow-doc gate applies.

## Dependencies

- Edge to the manifest item (documents it).
- Edge to the gate-wiring item (documents the script + gate).
data.title: Docs and barrel docblock for node-safe surface
